home.eyebrow: English learning, at a pace that lasts
home.title: Don’t just study English. Bring it into your life.
home.description: SAYVA is an English-learning space for building a habit, practicing with purpose, and finding your own path—calmly, clearly, consistently.
home.heroAlt: A quiet study desk with a notebook, navy book, and brass pen
home.heroCaption: Less scattered. More in the flow.
home.signalEyebrow: For making progress, not just starting
home.signalDescription: Language learning lasts when you know why you are practicing, what to focus on, and what comes next.

clarity.title: A clear path
clarity.body: Start from where you are and follow a learning path that makes the next step easy to see.

practice.title: Purposeful practice
practice.body: Practice is not filler. Every exercise has a meaningful place in the path.

context.title: Language in context
context.body: See words and sentences in situations that feel closer to real life.

home.methodTitle: Good learning happens in the right order.
home.methodDescription: SAYVA shapes an experience that starts with noticing, grows through practice, and arrives at use.

start.title: Start from you
start.body: Begin with what you know and what you want to be able to do.

build.title: Build through practice
build.body: Use short, meaningful repetitions to move from knowing toward doing.

use.title: Make it yours
use.body: Take English off the page and use it in thought, work, and conversation.

home.focusEyebrow: An experience that respects your attention
home.focusBody: You should not be thrown from one screen to the next. Each part is designed to make your place, purpose, and next move clear.
focusPoints: A simple structure for fewer decisions
Feedback that makes the next step visible
home.focusCardTitle: One idea, one moment to understand
home.focusCardBody: A calm space to notice, think, and continue.
home.aiTitle: When you’re ready, the conversation begins.
home.aiBody: SAYVA’s intelligent capabilities are designed for practice and speaking—not to replace the learning path, but to bring it closer to your life.
home.closingEyebrow: The next step can be simple
home.closingBody: With SAYVA, learning becomes less like one big decision and more like a series of steps you can take.

features.metadataDescription: The SAYVA capabilities for clear, purposeful, human English learning.
features.title: Everything to learn better, not just see more.
features.description: SAYVA brings together tools and experiences that help you move forward with more focus, practice, and confidence.
features.gridEyebrow: Six pillars of the SAYVA experience

path.title: A clear learning path
path.body: Instead of an endless content list, you get a structure that makes the next step easy to understand.

practice.title: Practice in the right place
practice.body: Practice works best when it connects to what you have just learned.

context.title: Words in context
context.body: Learn words closer to life—in sentences, situations, and use.

ai.title: AI with a defined role
ai.body: AI helps with practice and speaking. It is never the source of truth for your path, progress, or identity.

bilingual.title: Two languages, one experience
bilingual.body: Persian and English are both first-class experiences, with the right readability and direction.

calm.title: Designed for focus
calm.body: Color, space, and motion support the content instead of competing with it.

features.closingTitle: More tools are not always the answer.
features.closingBody: SAYVA tries to build each part with a clear intention: help you understand, practice, and use.

experience.metadataDescription: A closer look at the SAYVA learning experience, from starting point to real use.
experience.title: Learning lasts when it fits your life.
experience.description: A good experience does not leave you alone with a mountain of content. It helps you pay attention, practice, and use English with more confidence.
experience.principlesTitle: Three simple moves, one complete path

notice.title: Notice and understand
notice.body: Every path starts by paying attention to language: a word, a pattern, a sentence worth seeing.

practice.title: Practice and return
practice.body: Short exercises and thoughtful returns help learning move beyond short-term memory.

speak.title: Put it to use
speak.body: The goal is not knowing about English. It is being able to use it in the moment.

experience.rhythmTitle: Every day will not look the same.
experience.rhythmBody: Some days give you ten minutes, some give you more. SAYVA is designed to value continuity over intensity.
rhythmPoints: A small start with less friction
Clear signals for what comes next
A space that respects your attention
experience.quote: Learning is a collection of small moments of returning.
experience.closingBody: Explore the SAYVA approach and see what a clear learning experience can feel like.

about.metadataDescription: The thinking behind SAYVA’s precise, human English-learning experience.
about.title: English, with more care and less pressure.
about.description: SAYVA starts with a question: how can we build an experience that makes language learning clearer, more human, and easier to continue?
about.storyTitle: Not a content list. A relationship with learning.
about.storyBody: We believe in a product that listens before it speaks, clarifies the path instead of crowding the screen, and replaces big promises with one doable step at a time.

clarity.title: Clarity before complexity
clarity.body: If something does not help you understand, it does not belong in the path.

human.title: Technology with a human feel
human.body: Intelligence should bring the experience closer, not make it colder or more distant.

craft.title: Details with intention
craft.body: Space, words, movement, and color are all part of learning quality.

about.identityTitle: International in outlook, rooted in detail.
about.identityBody: SAYVA’s visual language draws from architectural order, quiet geometry, and the calm of study spaces—without repeating clichés or adding decoration for its own sake.
about.closingTitle: SAYVA is built for the path.

faq.metadataDescription: Answers to common questions about SAYVA’s public vision and learning experience.
faq.title: A few clear answers before the next step.
faq.description: If your question is not here, access and support details will be introduced clearly as the public product becomes available.

what.question: What is SAYVA?
what.answer: SAYVA is a bilingual English-learning platform that brings together a clear path, purposeful practice, and a calmer learning experience.

who.question: Who is SAYVA for?
who.answer: For learners who want to bring English into everyday life through consistent, useful practice—at any starting point and at a sustainable pace.

ai.question: What role does AI have in SAYVA?
ai.answer: AI capabilities support practice and speaking in a defined role. AI is never the source of truth for your curriculum, progress, account, or learning history.

bilingual.question: Are both Persian and English supported?
bilingual.answer: Yes. Persian is a first-class right-to-left experience and English is a first-class left-to-right experience, from copy and spacing to menus and layout.

method.question: How is SAYVA different from a lesson list?
method.answer: SAYVA is not only about presenting content. It is about sequence, returning, practice, and turning knowledge into use.

start.question: Where should I start?
start.answer: Start with the Features and Learning experience pages. They explain the SAYVA approach; access details will be shared clearly when the public product is released.

faq.ctaBody: If you did not find the answer, explore the learning experience in more detail.

permission.title: Microphone permission
